what: Hovering a work card slowly scales the photo to 1.05 over 5s, a glass veil (translucent stage color + blur) covers it in .8s, and a small center photo opens with a clip from the left (.8s). From the bottom of the photo a row of feature tags rises from 1em below in .3s, a text-colored band is drawn from the left across the title below so the letters flip (.3s), and the description slides up 1em out while the tags come in from 1em below in its place. On release the photo returns in 1.2s.

options.--fx-md: Curtain and small photo duration, default .8s
options.--fx-sm: Label, title strip and description length, default .3s
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Photo frame (overflow hidden) — contains thumb, veil, feats
options.[data-fx-part=pop]: Small photo that opens from the left of the curtain’s center (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=feats]: Caption line rising from below the photo (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=title]: Title with a text-color band drawn across it (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Caption that slides upward (optional) · [data-fx-part=swap] optional tag that takes its place (overlaps with position:absolute inside the same parent as text)

use:

note: Hover reactions only on devices that support hover — on touch, the original shape stays as is. Curtain color is --kf-contrast-bg 50%
